reports.title: Alto Neuroscience Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights

desk.headline: Loss of $0.54 a share, narrower than expected; $320m cash after $100m raise, runway through 2030
results: Alto has no product sales; the net loss grew to $25.1m from $14.2m as spending on its lead depression drug ALTO-207 rose.
Research costs climbed to $18.2m and administrative costs to $9.1m on more trials and staff.
A $100m share sale in July at $26.48 a share lifted cash to $319.8m, which the company expects to fund plans through 2030.
The PACE-1 mid-stage trial of ALTO-207 in treatment-resistant depression remains on track, and a second Phase 3 trial (monotherapy) has been added.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance. Alto expects its cash to last through 2030 and listed 2027 milestones, including ALTO-300 data in H1 2027, ALTO-100 data mid-2027 and PACE-1 results in H2 2027.

watch: FDA feedback and Phase 1 data on ALTO-207, expected late 2026 or early 2027.
Start of the PACE-2 Phase 3 trial in early 2027.
ALTO-300 Phase 2b results in depression, due H1 2027.
